description: Estimates the hours a week AI could save one person or a team, from the hours spent on seven everyday task types (email, scheduling, quotes and invoices, data entry, customer questions, documents, marketing), using a share per task informed by IPPR and McKinsey research. Returns a range and the task with the biggest saving. Free, no key. Docs: https://aeolookup.com/ai-calculators/ai-time-saved-calculator/

customers.description: Hours a week one person spends on answering customer questions (phone, chat, email) (default 0).

data.description: Hours a week one person spends on data entry, admin and updating records (default 0).

documents.description: Hours a week one person spends on reports, proposals and documents (default 0).

email.description: Hours a week one person spends on email and messages (default 0).

marketing.description: Hours a week one person spends on social posts, newsletters and marketing copy (default 0).

people.description: How many people spend their week like this (default 1).

quotes.description: Hours a week one person spends on quotes, invoices and chasing payments (default 0).

scheduling.description: Hours a week one person spends on scheduling, bookings and reminders (default 0).

name: calculate_ai_time_saved
title: AI time-saved calculator
